svg.aria-label: The disclosure mode, simple view. Boxes: academic-paper 3.2.0: You name the venue, and paste the policy of a venue it does not know (stop); You confirm each uncertain kind of AI use (stop); Formatter (agent, only when needed) | paper: Intake: the venue or the policy anchor, the policy of a venue not listed, the kinds of AI use the records leave uncertain; you confirm (stop); Draft writer: the statements (agent); Draft writer once more: the model identifier, when the model list gave none (agent, only when needed).
